_readme: Service codes for the Codes page. The ECU reports faults as OBD-II codes (13 01 -> 53 01 03 40 = P0340);
obd_code links each one to the service code the dash shows. obd_code_seen: a real ski sent that code for this
fault. The others are the standard OBD-II code for the same sensor or circuit, and Kawasaki doesn't always use
the standard one: with the oil temp sensor unplugged an Ultra LX sent P1112, not P0195.
dash: what the meter shows in dealer mode. ecu_pins: ECU connector pins to check. fail_safe: what the ECU does
source: Kawasaki Ultra LX Service Manual, Fuel System (DFI) 3-22/3-23 Service Code Table; ECU pins from 3-18 Terminal Names

codes.name: Throttle sensor
codes.fault: Throttle sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Throttle sensor connector unplugged or corroded
Broken/shorted wire between sensor and ECU
Loss of 5 V sensor supply or sensor ground (shared with other sensors)
codes.fail_safe: Ignition timing locked to closed-throttle timing; fueling switches to D-J (pressure/RPM) method.

codes.name: Inlet air pressure (MAP) sensor
codes.fault: Inlet air pressure sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: MAP sensor connector unplugged or corroded
Vacuum hose off, cracked or blocked
Loss of 5 V sensor supply or sensor ground

codes.name: Inlet air temperature sensor
codes.fault: Inlet air temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: IAT sensor connector unplugged or corroded

codes.name: Water temperature sensor
codes.fault: Water temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Water temp sensor connector unplugged or corroded

codes.name: Crankshaft sensor
codes.fault: Crankshaft sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Sensor air gap or damaged/dirty pickup
Failed sensor (check resistance and peak voltage)
codes.fail_safe: None listed (engine will not run without crank signal).

codes.name: Camshaft position sensor
codes.fault: Camshaft position sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Cam timing off after engine work
codes.fail_safe: Continues firing in the same sequence as the last good signal.

codes.name: Vehicle-down sensor
codes.fault: Vehicle-down sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Sensor mounted incorrectly or ski on its side
codes.fail_safe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.name: Key collation error
causes: Key not registered to this ECU
Interference from another key or metal near the key

codes.name: Fuel pump relay (open)
codes.fault: Fuel pump relay malfunction, wiring open
causes: Open relay coil or broken control wire

codes.name: Fuel pump relay (stuck)
codes.fault: Fuel pump relay malfunction, relay is stuck

codes.name: Ignition coil #1/#4
codes.fault: Ignition coil #1, #4 malfunction, wiring open or short
codes.fail_safe: Injectors #1/#4 shut off (cylinders 1 and 4 get no fuel).

codes.name: Ignition coil #2/#3
codes.fault: Ignition coil #2, #3 malfunction, wiring open or short
codes.fail_safe: Injectors #2/#3 shut off (cylinders 2 and 3 get no fuel).

codes.name: Engine overheat
causes: Clogged cooling water inlet or pickup (weeds, sand)
Running out of water too long
Water temp sensor reading falsely high
codes.fail_safe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.name: Engine oil pressure low
causes: Oil pressure switch connector unplugged or wire shorted to ground
codes.fail_safe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.name: Oil temperature sensor
codes.fault: Oil temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Oil temp sensor connector unplugged or corroded
codes.fail_safe: ECU assumes 60 °C oil and limits engine below 3000 rpm.

codes.name: Main (ECU) relay / system relay
codes.fault: Main (ECU) relay and system relay malfunction, wiring open or relay stuck

codes.name: Engine oil overheat
causes: Oil temp sensor reading falsely high
codes.fail_safe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.
